name: Full Synthetic User Journey - ViOS Production
description: Comprehensive E2E autonomous test for https://tuvitoantap.online: Checks dashboard, Wallet & VietQR TPBank, Daily Checkin, Ziwei Chart generation, and AI explanation blur-teaser.

planSteps.description: Open https://tuvitoantap.online and wait for the application to load completely.
The app should display the royal imperial theme header 'Tử Vi Toàn Tập' and not display any error screen or broken layout.
Navigate to /wallet to inspect the Wallet and Daily Checkin interface.
The wallet page loads successfully with heading 'Ví XU & Điểm Danh', showing the TPBank account '36889338888', account holder 'LE VAN TINH', and VietQR code image.
Locate the Daily Checkin button on the wallet page and click it if it is active.
The checkin action executes without displaying 'Database error while checking in', showing either a success toast/streak or already checked-in status.
Navigate back to the home page or chart creation view (/).
Fill the birth data form with valid Gregorian date: Day 18, Month 8, Year 1995, Gender Male, Hour 10, Minute 30, and submit to create the Ziwei chart.
The URL should transition to /charts/<uuid> and the square 12-palace Ziwei board should render properly.
The page must not display 'Không tải được chi tiết lá số' and must offer royal explanation features.
